title: thefuck splits PATH on ':' on every platform
prompt:
On Windows, PATH entries are separated by `;`, but thefuck splits PATH on `:` when it lists the available executables (`thefuck.utils.get_all_executables`). With `PATH=C:\foo;C:\bar` it looks in directories such as `C` and `\foo;C`, so commands are not found and suggestions are wrong. PATH must be split with the separator of the platform thefuck runs on.

Tests: `python -m pytest -q tests` (the functional tests skip themselves without Docker).
